standard.summary: torch.compile inductor 融合与自动调优策略
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.epilogue: 点算尽量融进 matmul 尾巴。
optionDescriptions.max_autotune: 多 benchmark 几次选 kernel，第一次很久。

standard_en.summary: The torch.compile inductor fusion and autotuning policy.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.epilogue: Folds pointwise ops into the tail of the matmul where it can.
optionDescriptions.max_autotune: Benchmarks several kernels before choosing; the first run takes a long time.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Pushes fusion and tuning one gear further.

advanced.principle: 调整 torch.compile inductor 的算子融合与自动调优策略。off=不改 inductor 默认；epilogue=保证 epilogue fusion（pointwise 融入 matmul 尾部，现代 torch 已默认但此项明确锁定）；max_autotune=额外 benchmark 选最优 GEMM kernel（首次编译变慢，稳态提速）；aggressive=再加 coordinate descent 搜索（编译最慢，稳态最优）。

advanced_en.principle: Adjusts torch.compile inductor op-fusion and autotuning strategy. off = leave inductor defaults untouched; epilogue = guarantee epilogue fusion (pointwise ops fused into matmul tails — modern torch already defaults to this, but this option pins it explicitly); max_autotune = extra benchmarking to pick the best GEMM kernel (slower first compile, faster steady state); aggressive = adds coordinate-descent search on top (slowest compile, best steady state).
